cross_cutting_findings.summary: Fresh install bypassed profile onboarding on clean emulator; likely initialization race, unproven exact root cause.
Cloud assistant voice and local capture voice are separate paths but labels/placement do not clearly distinguish intent.
More report pushes directory links below first viewport.
Action-result open-related callbacks do not consistently pass exact object IDs.
Tasks shows assistant tasks and a separate test/prototype store in one destination.
Line/surface contrast is below 3:1 for boundaries in both themes; manually computed from current theme colors.
System Back dismisses nested saved-object dialog instead of consistently popping internal detail; stale selectedTask is possible.
Several Cases/saved-object/Home/Finance error states lack in-place retry; Calendar and Inbox have retry/refresh.
Cases status filter horizontal overflow is not obvious.

verification_limits: No populated synthetic relationships or finance/task records on emulator
No large-font or dark-theme visual pass in this Stage 0
No mic, speech, Gemini, network AI, or personal data
AndroidTest APK compiled but instrumentation did not run
No UI or runtime implementation changes made
